tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get details about currently selected nodes.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get detailed properties of a node by ID. Use depth to limit child recursion (0 = node only, 1 = direct children, etc). Default: unlimited.

tools.name: find_nodes
tools.description: Find nodes by name pattern and/or type.

tools.name: get_jsx
tools.description: Get JSX representation of a node and its children. Compact round-trip format — same syntax as the render tool.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render JSX to design nodes. Supports inline SVG paths, including open stroked paths: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" size={24}><path d="M2 12 L22 12" stroke="#000" fill="none" /></svg>. Use replace_id to replace a placeholder while preserving its position.
tools.limits: Declarative JSX, data constants and design helpers; no executable JavaScript or implicit remote Icon elements.

tools.name: update_node
tools.description: Update properties of an existing node: position, size, opacity, corner radius, visibility, text, font.

tools.name: set_layout
tools.description: Set auto-layout (flexbox) on a frame. Direction, alignment, spacing, padding.

tools.name: set_layout_child
tools.description: Configure auto-layout child: sizing (FIXED/HUG/FILL), grow, alignment, absolute positioning.

tools.name: set_radius
tools.description: Set corner radius. Use individual corners for independent values.

tools.name: set_fill
tools.description: Set fill on a node. Solid: color="#ff0000". Linear gradient: gradient="top-bottom" or "left-right" with color (start) and color_end (end).

tools.name: set_stroke
tools.description: Set the stroke (border) of a node.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Set text content of a text node.

tools.name: set_text_properties
tools.description: Set text layout properties: alignment, auto-resize, text case, decoration, truncation.

tools.name: delete_node
tools.description: Delete a node by ID.

tools.name: reparent_node
tools.description: Move a node into a different parent.

tools.name: node_resize
tools.description: Resize a node.

tools.name: batch_update
tools.description: Execute multiple modifications in one call. Each operation is {id, props} where props can include: spacing, padding, padding_horizontal, padding_vertical, counter_align, sizing_horizontal, sizing_vertical, grow, name, visible, corner_radius, auto_resize (for text), direction. Runs all updates with one layout recompute.

tools.name: stock_photo
tools.description: Search stock photos and apply to leaf image placeholders or closed area geometry. Pass a JSON array; each item is {id, query, index?, orientation?}. Containers with content, text, lines, and structural nodes are rejected.
tools.limits: Typed bounded native service requests, keychain-only provider credentials, source attribution and atomic document publication. Mocked connected-workflow checks; actual provider/desktop/renderer/export fidelity and aggregate resource acceptance remain unverified.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Semantic description of one or more nodes. Pass `id` for a single node, or `ids` for multiple nodes in one call. Omit depth for auto — adapts to subtree size (small block → deeper, large page → shallower).

tools.name: calc
tools.description: Arithmetic calculator. ALWAYS use instead of mental math. Pass one expression or a JSON array of expressions — all evaluated in one call. Supports: + - * / % ** ( ) min max floor ceil round abs sqrt pow. Examples: "844 - 56 - 96 - 82", '["1440 * 8 / 12", "(952 - 16) / 2", "floor(390 * 0.6)"]'

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Execute JavaScript with full Figma Plugin API access. Use for operations not covered by other tools. The `figma` global is available.
tools.limits: Published figma API on a separate draft in an opaque worker; checked graph and one-step history. Local admission/timeout limits; live browser/native isolation and renderer-dependent APIs remain unverified.

tools.name: viewport_zoom_to_fit
tools.description: Zoom viewport to fit specified nodes.

tools.name: get_page_tree
tools.description: Get the node tree of the current page. Returns lightweight hierarchy: id, type, name, size. Use depth, root_id, or node_types to keep large pages small. Use get_node for full properties of a specific node.

tools.name: get_current_page
tools.description: Get the current page name and ID.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List all pages in the document.

tools.name: select_nodes
tools.description: Select one or more nodes by ID.

tools.name: query_nodes
get_components
tools.description: List reusable components from the document and enabled component libraries, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List available published component libraries.

tools.name: insert_library_component
tools.description: Insert a reusable component from an enabled library by stable library and asset identity.

tools.name: switch_page
tools.description: Switch to a different page by name or ID.

tools.name: page_bounds
tools.description: Get bounding box of all objects on the current page.

tools.name: get_font_status
tools.description: Report whether fonts used on the current page are faithfully available. Returns requested faces, their loaded source, active substitutions, and affected nodes.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List fonts used in the current page.

tools.name: list_available_fonts
tools.description: List font families the host can render (system fonts on desktop plus any bundled fonts). Use this to discover what fonts are available to set on a text node — distinct from list_fonts which only reports families currently used in the page.

tools.name: diff_jsx
tools.description: Structural diff between two nodes in JSX format. Shows added/removed children, changed props.

tools.name: create_shape
tools.description: Create a shape on the canvas. Use FRAME for containers/cards, RECTANGLE for solid blocks, ELLIPSE for circles, TEXT for labels, LINE for rules and dividers, STAR for starbursts and badges, POLYGON for triangles and regular polygons, and SECTION for page sections. Use create_vector with an SVG path for arbitrary shapes.

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search Iconify for icons by keyword. Accepts multiple queries — all searched in parallel. Returns results keyed by query.
tools.limits: Typed bounded native service requests, keychain-only provider credentials, source attribution and atomic document publication. Mocked connected-workflow checks; actual provider/desktop/renderer/export fidelity and aggregate resource acceptance remain unverified.

tools.name: insert_icon
tools.description: Insert one or more vector icons onto the canvas. Pass a single name or multiple names to batch-insert into the same parent. If already cached by fetch_icons — instant, no network request.
tools.limits: Typed bounded native service requests, keychain-only provider credentials, source attribution and atomic document publication. Mocked connected-workflow checks; actual provider/desktop/renderer/export fidelity and aggregate resource acceptance remain unverified.

tools.name: fetch_icons
tools.description: Pre-fetch icons from Iconify into cache. Batches by prefix (one HTTP request per set). Call this once with all needed icons, then use insert_icon to place them instantly. Popular sets: lucide (outline), mdi (filled), heroicons, tabler, solar, mingcute, ri (remix).
tools.limits: Typed bounded native service requests, keychain-only provider credentials, source attribution and atomic document publication. Mocked connected-workflow checks; actual provider/desktop/renderer/export fidelity and aggregate resource acceptance remain unverified.

tools.name: combine_as_variants
tools.description: Combine components sharing a parent into a component set (variant set). Components named "Category/Value" (e.g. "Button/Primary") derive variant properties from the name segments.

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Convert a frame/group into a component.

tools.name: create_instance
tools.description: Create an instance of a component.

tools.name: expose_instance_swap
tools.description: Expose nested instances as an instance-swap slot on their component.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page.

tools.name: create_vector
tools.description: Create a vector node from SVG path data or a VectorNetwork.

tools.name: create_slice
tools.description: Create a slice (export region) on the canvas.

tools.name: import_svg
tools.description: Import raw SVG markup onto the canvas as editable vector nodes. Supports common SVG shapes, inherited presentation attributes, transforms, gradients, and internal <use> references.

tools.name: set_effects
tools.description: Set effects on a node (drop shadow, inner shadow, blur). Pass an array or a single effect.

tools.name: set_opacity
tools.description: Set opacity of a node (0-1).

tools.name: set_font
tools.description: Set font properties of a text node.

tools.name: set_visible
tools.description: Set visibility of a node.

tools.name: set_constraints
tools.description: Set resize constraints for a node within its parent.

tools.name: set_rotation
tools.description: Set rotation angle of a node in degrees.

tools.name: set_minmax
tools.description: Set min/max width and height constraints on a node.

tools.name: set_font_range
tools.description: Set font properties for a text range.

tools.name: set_text_resize
tools.description: Set text auto-resize mode.

tools.name: set_blend
tools.description: Set blend mode of a node.

tools.name: set_locked
tools.description: Set locked state of a node.

tools.name: set_stroke_align
tools.description: Set stroke alignment of a node.

tools.name: set_image_fill
tools.description: Set an image fill on a node from base64-encoded image data.

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Clone (duplicate) a node.

tools.name: node_move
tools.description: Move a node to new coordinates.

tools.name: rename_node
tools.description: Rename a node in the layers panel.

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group selected nodes.

tools.name: ungroup_node
tools.description: Ungroup a group node.

tools.name: flatten_nodes
tools.description: Flatten nodes into a single vector.

tools.name: node_to_component
tools.description: Convert one or more frames/groups into components.

tools.name: node_bounds
tools.description: Get absolute bounding box of a node.

tools.name: node_ancestors
tools.description: Get the ancestor chain from a node to the page root.

tools.name: node_children
tools.description: Get direct children of a node.

tools.name: node_tree
tools.description: Get a node tree with types and hierarchy.

tools.name: node_bindings
tools.description: Get variable bindings for a node.

tools.name: node_replace_with
tools.description: Replace a node with JSX content.

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Arrange top-level nodes on the canvas in a grid, row, or column layout. Useful after batch creation to tidy up overlapping frames.

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: List all design variables (colors, numbers, strings, booleans).

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all variable collections.

tools.name: get_variable
tools.description: Get a variable by ID.

tools.name: find_variables
tools.description: Find variables by name pattern.

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable in a collection.

tools.name: set_variable
tools.description: Set the value of a variable for a specific mode.

tools.name: delete_variable
tools.description: Delete a variable.

tools.name: bind_variable
tools.description: Bind a variable to a node property. For fills/strokes color bindings use indexed format like "fills/0/color".

tools.name: unbind_variable
tools.description: Remove a variable binding from a node property.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get a variable collection by ID.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new variable collection.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a variable collection and all its variables.

tools.name: boolean_union
tools.description: Union (combine) multiple nodes.

tools.name: boolean_subtract
tools.description: Subtract the second node from the first.

tools.name: boolean_intersect
tools.description: Intersect multiple nodes.

tools.name: boolean_exclude
tools.description: Exclude (XOR) multiple nodes.

tools.name: path_get
tools.description: Get vector path data of a node.

tools.name: path_set
tools.description: Set vector path data on a node. Provide a VectorNetwork JSON.

tools.name: path_scale
tools.description: Scale vector path from center.

tools.name: path_flip
tools.description: Flip vector path horizontally or vertically.

tools.name: path_move
tools.description: Move all path points by an offset.

tools.name: viewport_get
tools.description: Get current viewport position and zoom level.

tools.name: viewport_set
tools.description: Set viewport position and zoom.

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Export nodes as SVG markup. Returns the SVG string.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Export nodes as a vector PDF document. Text remains selectable, paths stay sharp at any zoom. Returns base64-encoded PDF data.

tools.name: export_image
tools.description: Export nodes as a raster image (PNG, JPG, or WEBP). Returns base64-encoded image data. Use to visually verify designs.

tools.name: analyze_colors
tools.description: Analyze color palette usage across the current page. Shows frequency, variable bindings, and optionally clusters similar colors.

tools.name: analyze_typography
tools.description: Analyze typography usage across the current page. Shows font families, sizes, weights, and their frequencies.

tools.name: analyze_spacing
tools.description: Analyze spacing values (gap, padding) across the current page. Checks grid compliance.

tools.name: analyze_clusters
tools.description: Find repeated design patterns (potential components). Groups nodes by structural signature — type, size, and child structure.

tools.name: analyze_overlaps
tools.description: Detect visual overlaps and layout overflows across the current page. Useful for finding content that covers footers, text that bleeds outside frames, and accidental sibling overlaps.

tools.name: diff_create
tools.description: Create a structural diff between two node trees. Compares properties (fills, strokes, effects, text, size, position) in unified diff format.

tools.name: diff_show
tools.description: Preview what would change if properties were applied to a node. Shows a unified diff of current vs proposed state.

tools.name: design_to_tokens
tools.description: Extract design tokens from Figma variables as CSS custom properties, Tailwind theme config, or JSON. Resolves aliases, handles multiple modes (light/dark).

tools.name: design_to_component_map
tools.description: Analyze the document and return a structured component decomposition: components (with variants, props, instance counts), screens, and a dependency overview.

auditNote: Integration records reachability. Smoke tests cover only their stated cases, not full upstream feature parity or visual fidelity. Dedicated control detection is a static inventory, not an end-to-end UI test.
